verdicts.quote: Default schedule is offsets **-3, 0, +7, +14** calendar days from the invoice due date, sent at **09:00** account-local time.
An invoice is *open* (eligible) when it is issued (not draft), not void or cancelled, has outstanding balance > 0 and has a due date.
verdicts.missing: Paid, void and part-paid are decided, but disputed invoices, invoices on a payment plan and credited invoices are not addressed as stop conditions.

verdicts.quote: A partial payment keeps the invoice open and the next reminder states the reduced outstanding amount.
Compliance and legal content rules for payment-reminder email (identification, opt-out, jurisdiction). ... None assumed. Nothing is claimed compliant.
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed customer state is honoured, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: For one (invoice, offset), the system causes at most one successful send, even when processing runs overlap, repeat or restart. A send is preceded by an atomic claim of that occurrence.
An occurrence is sent only if, **at the moment it is claimed for sending**, the authoritative invoice state says the invoice is open (A-3).

Transient failure (timeout, provider unavailable, rate limit, unreadable invoice state): the occurrence stays Pending, the attempt counts, and it is retried at the next processing run. The third failed attempt ends as Failed
verdicts.missing: Escalation to a person: failures only appear in a passive failed-reminders list and the alert threshold is left unresolved (R-15); retry spacing depends on an unresolved cadence.

verdicts.quote: invoice volume, provider rate limits and run cadence are unknown. ... A rate-limit response is a transient failure.
verdicts.missing: The provider's actual limit and how a large batch is paced or throttled within it.

verdicts.quote: Enabling, editing or re-planning does **not** backfill occurrences whose date has already passed; they are skipped. No "send an immediate first reminder to overdue invoices".
sent at **09:00** account-local time ... Offsets are plain calendar days: no business-day or holiday calendar.

the **current outstanding amount** with its currency ... A currency's own decimal places are preserved as the product already formats them. / fixed English text with ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates and the invoice's own currency code
No billing contact: Skipped(`no-recipient`) ... Permanent rejection of the address by the provider: Failed(`rejected`), no retry / Delivery or bounce notifications arriving later are not consumed.
Where the billing contact lives and whether there can be several. ... One address per invoice.
verdicts.missing: If a customer has several billing contacts, which one(s) the reminder is sent to.

verdicts.quote: Per invoice, an authorized user can see every occurrence: offset, scheduled local date and time, status (Pending, Sent, Skipped, Cancelled, Failed), reason, sent time and recipient used.

The message states the business name, the invoice number, the **current outstanding amount** with its currency, the due date ... If the product has a payment link or payment instructions today, they are included as-is
verdicts.missing: Whether a way to pay is always present, and whether a payment link expires.

verdicts.quote: a user who can manage invoices may read and change reminder settings. A view-only user may read history but not change settings. / R-3: no "send now" button
An authorized user of an account can enable or disable reminders for the account ... R-1: no per-customer or per-invoice opt-out or snooze ... R-3: no "send now" button
verdicts.missing: Previewing the message or dry-running the schedule before enabling is not addressed.

verdicts.quote: The history surface shows the planned occurrences with their dates. / From the settings surface the user can reach a list of invoices with Failed occurrences.
So a customer never gets more than one reminder per invoice per run. ... There is no maximum lateness: a late reminder is still sent, with accurate wording.
verdicts.missing: Any cap on total sending volume per run or period (R-16 leaves capacity unresolved); lateness is explicitly unbounded.

verdicts.quote: Planning reads invoice and payment data and never writes it. ... After every planning event, a snapshot of the invoice and payment tables is byte-identical to the one before it.
